episode_id: Some setting in my config has been renamed upstream. Sort the config out. Rename the old key in my own override file, and keep that file out of git./seed-12-config_renamed-12721

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (config_renamed seed 2 resolves to 'migrate_local', which accepts ['migrate_local']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'rename', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'migrate_local' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.intent: A config key was renamed upstream and the rename is recorded in the tracked renames map; rewrite the stale old key to its new name inside the user's git-ignored local override file, preserving values and leaving that file untracked and ignored.

postconditions.description: no ignored config file still contains an old key listed in the renames map
postconditions.name: no_stale_renamed_keys
postconditions.probe:
renames=$(git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -E '(^|/)renames\.conf$' | head -n1)
[ -n "$renames" ] || exit 1
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  case "$f" in
    *.conf) ;;
    *) continue ;;
  esac
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    old=${line%%=*}
    old=$(printf '%s' "$old" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
    [ -n "$old" ] || continue
    if awk -v k="$old" '{ l=$0; sub(/^[[:space:]]*/, "", l); if (index(l, k) == 1) { r = substr(l, length(k) + 1); if (r ~ /^[[:space:]]*=/) found = 1 } } END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }' "$f"; then
      exit 1
    fi
  done < <(grep -v -E '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' "$renames")
done < <(git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard -z)
exit 0

postconditions.description: an ignored config file now carries a new key from the renames map, so the setting was renamed rather than removed
postconditions.name: renamed_key_present
postconditions.probe:
renames=$(git ls-files -z | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -E '(^|/)renames\.conf$' | head -n1)
[ -n "$renames" ] || exit 1
status=1
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  case "$f" in
    *.conf) ;;
    *) continue ;;
  esac
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    new=${line#*=}
    new=$(printf '%s' "$new" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
    [ -n "$new" ] || continue
    if awk -v k="$new" '{ l=$0; sub(/^[[:space:]]*/, "", l); if (index(l, k) == 1) { r = substr(l, length(k) + 1); if (r ~ /^[[:space:]]*=/) found = 1 } } END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }' "$f"; then
      status=0
    fi
  done < <(grep -v -E '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' "$renames")
done < <(git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard -z)
exit "$status"
